narration: In month {fork_month}, with the first payslip lighter than the offer letter, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, in that same month. From there the ghost's money stayed ahead for {ghost_ahead_months} months. In month {layoff_month} the layoff reached you both, and at that month's close, the widest the money ever stood apart, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. Its fallback against a stretch with no pay finished {safety_gap}.
